note: Family-owned campground and country store established 1995, on Skin Creek Rd about 1.5 mi east of I-79 exit 96 in Lewis County. Store carries groceries, firewood, bait and fishing/hunting supplies; stocked catch-and-release fishing pond (no state licence needed), playground, laundry. Third-party listings report the 30-amp sites take rigs to about 50 ft with some pull-throughs, which the operator does not state. Official site serves over plain http only - its https certificate chain is broken. --Claude
